close_reason: Fixed in commit 3442ac2. Replaced UTCDate::from with UTCDate::new_validated at the two client-input sites (message.rs:357 sentAt, position.rs:166 lastReadAt). Malformed wire values now produce invalidProperties errors mirroring the existing senderExpiresAt / expiresAt patterns in the same crate. Two regression tests added with independent oracles. Out-of-scope follow-up: the bead also flagged that ReadPosition/set update accepts lastReadAt via the generic serde_json::from_value::<PatchObject> path where jmap-types::UTCDate's Deserialize impl uses From not new_validated; closing the deeper update-path exposure requires either patch-side validation in handlers or fixing the Deserialize impl in jmap-types. That is a broader workspace question and not addressed here.
description:
Sites:
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:354-363 (sentAt) — wraps client-supplied string via UTCDate::from(s), no validation.
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:444 (received_at) — wraps server-side now_str (always valid; OK).
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/position.rs:163 (last_read_at) — wraps client-supplied string via UTCDate::from(at).
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:248, src/emoji.rs:351, src/ban.rs:142, src/space.rs:825 — all wrap now_utc_string() (server-side, always valid).

The exposure is on the two client-input sites: sentAt and lastReadAt. UTCDate::new_validated would reject malformed input; UTCDate::from accepts any string.

Spec (RFC 8620 §1.4 via jmap-types::id.rs:165): UTCDate must be exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (20 chars, Z-terminated, all numeric positions ASCII digits).

Concrete failure modes:
1. Stored malformed timestamp survives serialize/deserialize through jmap-chat-types::UTCDate's Deserialize impl (which uses From, not new_validated — confirmed by grep). Downstream clients receive nonsense.
2. iso8601_before in helpers.rs slices on byte index &s[..19]; if the malformed string has a multi-byte UTF-8 char in the first 19 bytes (e.g. emoji, non-ASCII), the slice panics. Currently only space.rs:1321 and message.rs:408 call iso8601_before on UTCDate-derived strings (validated), so this panic is not reachable via those paths — but adding any future caller that calls iso8601_before on Message.sentAt or ReadPosition.lastReadAt re-opens it.
3. Date comparison correctness: storing a non-UTC RFC 3339 timestamp like '2025-06-01T12:00:00-05:00' (20 chars but ending in offset rather than Z) bypasses some checks and would be lex-compared incorrectly with UTC timestamps.

Fix: replace UTCDate::from with UTCDate::new_validated at both sites, fall through to invalidProperties on failure (the senderExpiresAt site in message.rs:386 already does this — copy the pattern).

This is an inconsistency in the same crate: 4 sites use new_validated, 2 client-input sites use unchecked from.
title: Message/set + ReadPosition/set construct UTCDate from unvalidated client strings
